description: Generate a complete design token system from a brand hex color. Returns OKLCH-derived colors (light + dark mode), typography pairing, spacing scale, border radius, shadows, WCAG contrast validation, APCA scoring, design intent brief, and a visual preview URL on tokven.dev. Output in CSS, Tailwind v4, Tailwind v3, or DTCG JSON. Tip: call get_token_preview first to let the user approve the palette visually.

colors.description: Scope of color output. 'primary' = primary only, 'primary-secondary' = primary + secondary, 'all' = full system (default)

hex.description: Brand color as hex, e.g. #7b5fff or 7b5fff

mood.description: Visual personality preset. One of: warm, cool, bold, dark, soft, minimal, brutalist, playful, vintage, luxury, nature, neon, corporate, retro. Defaults to cool.

naming.description: Token naming convention. 'shadcn' maps names to shadcn/ui conventions (bg→background, text→foreground, primary-on→primary-foreground, etc.). Defaults to 'default'.

secondary_hex.description: Custom hex for secondary color. If omitted, secondary is auto-derived from primary. Accepts #rrggbb, #rgb, or without #.

tertiary_hex.description: Custom hex for tertiary color. If omitted, tertiary is auto-derived from primary. Accepts #rrggbb, #rgb, or without #.

name: generate_tokens
title: Generate Design Tokens
